blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: End-to-end deep learning pipelines for camera-radar 3D object detection are well established in driver assistance systems and autonomous vehicles; however, adapting them to roadside-mounted infrastructure presents significant challenges. On vehicles, sensor heights, pitch angles, and relative geometries remain largely uniform, allowing end-to-end models to generalize effectively. On the contrary, roadside sensor installations vary drastically in height, tilt, and field of view across locations, rendering end-to-end models prone to failure and difficult to adapt without massive location-specific datasets. Hence, instead of designing a complex end-to-end pipeline for direct 3D bounding box estimation, a low-cost, resource-efficient two-stage approach is proposed for real-time 3D shape and orientation estimation. The first stage utilizes any off-the-shelf, state-of-the-art method to extract 2D camera bounding boxes and associated 3D radar points for each road user. The proposed second stage then processes these inputs to construct 3D oriented bounding boxes where radar data determines 3D position, predefined templates define size for each road user, and a tiny neural network predicts a site-specific and optimized yaw angle. The algorithm is successfully validated at a curved road with a junction for pedestrians, bicycles, and cars, where it achieves 25 frames per second on an NVIDIA Jetson ORIN for real-time applications.

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: RGB (red, green, blue) cameras and 3D automotive radar sensors are widely used for precise road user detection and tracking in advanced driver assistance systems (ADAS) and autonomous vehicle development [ 1 , 2 ] . Recently, with advancements in intelligent transportation systems (ITS), their deployment in roadside infrastructure setups has gained popularity for road user detection [ 3 , 4 , 5 , 6 ] . These sensors operate based on different principles, providing complementary information that, when fused, enhances the overall accuracy and robustness of detection. However, due to the sparse nature of radar point clouds, fusion with camera data is often limited to detecting road users as point objects associated with categories and speed [ 7 ] . Such point object detection identifies only sparse locations without shape or orientation details, limiting its practical usefulness. In contrast, representing road users as 3D oriented bounding boxes offers a comprehensive spatial understanding by capturing object size, position, and orientation, which are essential for accurate localization and tracking.

[7]. 这种点物体探测只识别出没有形状或方向细节的稀疏位置,限制了其实用性. 与此相反,道路使用者作为面向3D的边框,通过捕捉物体大小、位置和方向,提供了全面的空间理解,这对于准确定位和跟踪至关重要。

blocks.en: Extensive research exists on direct 3D object detection using lidar sensors [ 8 , 9 ] , as their high resolution enables precise 3D shape reconstruction. However, lidar’s high cost limits its practicality for intelligent transportation systems (ITS) that require widespread roadside deployment. Monocular camera-based 3D detection methods [ 10 , 11 , 12 ] are available but rely heavily on deep learning, demanding significant computational resources and large volumes of lidar-labelled data, which complicates real-time operation and development. Similarly, end-to-end deep learning-based fusion algorithms combining RGB cameras and radar [ 13 , 14 , 15 , 16 ] to predict 3D bounding boxes or bird’s-eye-view outputs depend heavily on 3D labels for training, further increasing complexity and cost.
blocks.zh: 关于使用lidar传感器进行直接3D物体探测的问题,存在着广泛的研究[8,9],因为其高分辨率能够精确的3D形状重建。 然而,Lidar的高成本限制了其对智能运输系统(ITS)的实用性,这些系统需要广泛的路边部署. 单机相机的立体探测方法[10,11,12]可供使用,但严重依赖深度学习,需要大量计算资源和大量Lidar标签数据,这使得实时操作和发展复杂化. 同样,结合RGB相机和雷达[13,14,15,16]的端到端的深层学习聚变算法来预测3D边框或鸟眼观的输出,在很大程度上依赖于3D标签进行训练,进一步增加了复杂性和成本.

blocks.en: On vehicles, sensor heights, pitch angles, and relative geometries remain largely uniform across different models, allowing end-to-end deep learning architectures to generalize effectively. In contrast, roadside camera and radar installations vary drastically in height, tilt, and field of view across locations. Consequently, an end-to-end fusion model trained on a specific roadside setup often fails at a new location because it learns feature mappings implicitly tied to that site’s exact spatial configuration and 3D ground truth. This heavy reliance on site-specific geometry fundamentally restricts the generalizability of end-to-end models. Therefore, rather than forcing a single end-to-end fusion model to generalize across diverse environments, which is both costly and time-consuming, a more practical engineering solution is to design lightweight algorithms that quickly adapt to new sensor mountings. By shifting the focus toward rapid, location-specific adaptation, accurate and real-time 3D perception of road users can be reliably achieved across varying roadside infrastructure.
blocks.zh: 在车辆上,传感器高度,投球角度,以及相对的几何美图在不同的型号上仍然基本一致,使得端到端的深层学习架构能够有效概括. 相比之下,路边的照相机和雷达装置在高度、倾斜度和不同地点的视野方面差异很大。 因此,在具体路边设置上训练的端到端聚变模型往往在新的地点失败,因为它学习了与该地点的精确空间配置和三维地面真实性隐含的特征绘图。 这种对特定地点几何的强烈依赖从根本上限制了端到端模型的通俗性. 因此,一个更实用的工程解决方案不是强迫单一的端对端核聚变模型在各种环境之间通用,既昂贵又耗时,而是设计能迅速适应新传感器安装的轻量级算法. 通过将重点转向快速、针对具体地点的适应、准确和实时的对道路使用者的三维感,可以可靠地通过各种路边基础设施实现。

blocks.en: II Related Work
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en: Camera-based methods demonstrate that 3D bounding boxes can be inferred from monocular images using geometry and prior physical knowledge. The approach in [ 17 ] projects the lower contour of segmentation masks onto the ground plane via camera calibration to estimate a vehicle’s footprint, from which height and orientation are derived geometrically. Similarly, [ 18 , 19 ] reconstruct 3D boxes by combining camera calibration, vanishing points, and statistical vehicle dimensions, while [ 20 ] introduces a lightweight network for estimating object orientation and scale. The work in [ 21 ] further employs known-size templates of various road users alongside road geometry to transform 2D detections into 3D boxes. However, due to inherent limitations in direct depth estimation from monocular images, camera-only methods suffer from relatively low positional accuracy, which deteriorates significantly as distance from the sensor increases.
blocks.zh: 基于相机的方法表明,利用几何学和之前的物理知识,从单视图像中可以推断出3D边框. [17]中的方法预测,通过照相机校准在地面平面上的隔膜的轮廓较低,以估计车辆的足迹,从高度和方向推导出几何。 同样,[18,19]通过将相机校准,消失点,统计车辆维度相结合来重建3D盒,而[20]则引入了轻量级网络来估计对象方向和尺度. [21]中的工作进一步使用了各种道路使用者已知大小的模板,与道路几何并列,将2D检测器转换成3D箱. 然而,由于由单极图像直接进行深度估计的固有局限性,只摄像头方法的定位精度相对较低,随着传感器距离的增加,这种精度明显恶化.

blocks.en: Radar sensors offer direct range and velocity measurements, making them ideal for precise spatial localization; however, processing radar data introduces unique algorithmic challenges due to severe point cloud sparsity, multipath reflections, and angular noise. Early short-range radar systems relied on beam-forming models [ 22 ] , though these were restricted to small sensing radii (e.g., within 5 m). To improve spatial understanding at longer distances, high-resolution radar approaches [ 23 ] employ classical geometric features, such as applying the Hough transform on radar point reflections to extract vehicle orientation. Multi-radar networks and hybrid deep learning setups [ 24 ] further extend detection range and point density, yet struggle with false positive detections caused by clutter. Additionally, traditional geometric strategies like convex hull extraction and L-shape fitting adapted from lidar processing [ 25 ] , as well as template matching techniques [ 26 ] , enhance interpretability but remain tailored exclusively to large, highly reflective objects like cars.
blocks.zh: 雷达传感器提供直接的射程和速度测量,使它们成为精确的空间定位的理想;然而,处理的雷达数据由于严重的点云溅射、多路径反射和角噪声而引入了独特的算法挑战。 早期的短程雷达系统依赖于光束成型模型[22],虽然这些模型仅限于小感光光度(如5米以内)。 为了在更长的距离上提高空间理解,高分辨率雷达方法[23]采用古典几何特征,例如在雷达点反射上应用Hough变换来提取飞行器方向. 多雷达网络和杂交深层学习设置[24]进一步扩大了检测范围和点密度,然而却与杂交导致的假阳性检测展开斗争. 此外,传统的几何策略,如从Lidar处理中改编的凸轮船体提取和L-形状装配,以及模板匹配技术[26],提高了可解释性,但仍完全适合汽车等大型、高反射物体。

blocks.en: While lidar-based architectures [ 27 , 28 , 29 ] achieve high 3D localization accuracy by processing dense spatial point clouds, these algorithms rely on fine spatial structures that do not translate directly to the significantly sparser and noisier distribution of radar targets.
blocks.zh: 虽然基于lidar的架构[27,28,29]通过处理密集的空间点云,实现了高3D本地化精度,但这些算法依赖于精细的空间结构,并不直接转化为雷达目标的显著稀疏和噪声分布.

blocks.en: To address these limitations without resorting to data-heavy end-to-end deep learning networks, this work strategically combines camera-based geometric projection and template-matching techniques with sparse radar point data to achieve accurate 3D positioning and sizing for road users. However, because classical geometric approaches struggle to reliably estimate yaw angles for bicycles and cars navigating curved roads and complex junctions, a tiny neural network optimized for site-specific performance is deployed in parallel. By coupling lightweight geometric priors with a compact model, the proposed framework achieves accurate, real-time 3D bounding box estimation with minimal computational overhead in a roadside camera-radar setup.
blocks.zh: 为了在不诉诸数据重的端到端深度学习网络的情况下解决这些局限性,这项工作将基于相机的几何投影和模板匹配技术与稀疏的雷达点数据战略结合,为道路使用者实现准确的三维定位和尺寸化. 然而,由于古典几何方法难以可靠地估计自行车和汽车导航曲线道路和复杂路口的yaw角度,因此平行部署一个为特定地点性能而优化的微小神经网络. 通过将轻量级几何前缀与紧凑模型组合起来,拟议的框架实现了准确的,实时的3D边框估计,在路边照相机-雷达设置中,计算间接费用最小。

blocks.en: IV Methodology
blocks.zh: 四. 方法

blocks.en: The proposed two-stage framework for 3D road user detection using a roadside RGB camera and 3D radar is illustrated in Fig. 2 . By decoupling instance association from 3D geometry estimation, this approach circumvents the need for complex, end-to-end deep learning models for direct 3D bounding box prediction. In Stage 1, processing is strictly restricted to 2D image detection and 3D radar point association, making it inherently independent of ground plane embeddings or location-specific camera-radar calibration priors. Subsequently, Stage 2 estimates the final 3D bounding boxes by deriving the 3D target positions directly from radar points, while leveraging predefined size templates and site-specific geometric constraints with minimal training data requirements. Consequently, rather than relying on complex end-to-end models that scale poorly to new sensor configurations in roadside sensor setups, Stage 2 focuses on finding an optimized, lightweight solution explicitly tailored for rapid, site-specific deployments.
blocks.zh: 图2说明了采用路边RGB摄像机和3D雷达进行3D道路用户探测的拟议两阶段框架。 通过将实例关联与3D几何估计脱钩,这种方法规避了直接3D边框预测对复杂,端到端深度学习模型的需求. 在第一阶段中,处理被严格限制在2D图像检测和3D雷达点关联上,使其在本质上独立于地面平面嵌入或特定位置的相机雷达校准前身. 随后,第2阶段通过直接从雷达点推导出3D目标位置,同时利用预定义的大小模板和特定地点的几何限制,对最终的3D边框进行估计,同时对培训数据要求最小. 因此,第2阶段的重点不是依靠复杂的端到端模型,这些模型在路边传感器设置中与新的传感器配置的尺度不相称,而是寻找一个明确适合快速和特定地点部署的优化的轻量级解决方案。

blocks.en: IV-B Stage 1: 2D Camera Detection and 3D Radar Association

blocks.en: In Stage 1, initial detections can be derived through state-of-the-art frame-wise object-level fusion [ 7 , 34 , 35 ] , leveraging camera detectors such as YOLOv11 [ 36 ] alongside radar-based clustering or deep learning segmentation [ 37 ] . Alternatively, feature-level radar-camera fusion can be employed, as described in prior work [ 30 ] . In our quantitative evaluation, Stage 1 uses YOLOv11 [ 36 ] (confidence threshold s i ≥ 0.5 s_{i}\geq 0.5 ) for 2D bounding box extraction paired with DBSCAN spatial clustering for 3D radar point association. Unassociated or empty radar clusters default to monocular ground-plane homography depth estimates. The primary objective of this stage is to extract candidate 2D bounding boxes 𝐛 i \mathbf{b}_{i} from the monocular image 𝐈 \mathbf{I} and isolate the corresponding 3D radar points 𝐏 i \mathbf{P}_{i} for each detected road user instance. The resulting output 𝐃 = { ( 𝐛 i , c i , s i , 𝐏 i ) } i = 1 N \mathbf{D}=\{(\mathbf{b}_{i},c_{i},s_{i},\mathbf{P}_{i})\}_{i=1}^{N} serves as a lightweight, domain-agnostic representation containing all required multi-modal spatial cues for subsequent 3D estimation.

blocks.en: Bicycle: Due to the sparse nature of the 3D radar sensor, most frames contain very few returns ( 2 2 to 4 4 points) per bicycle, and frequently only a single point is detected. blocks.en: V Experimental results and discussions
blocks.zh: 五. 实验结果和讨论

blocks.en: Manually labeled 3D bounding boxes from the lidar sensor serve as the ground truth (GT) data in this work. Distinct datasets are dedicated to training and validating the YawPredictionNet models. At the same time, a separate, independent set of 500 500 frames containing 451 451 persons, 360 360 bicycles, and 299 299 cars is reserved exclusively for validating the final 3D OBB outcome of the proposed methodology and is omitted from parameter tuning. To prevent temporal data leakage, dataset splits are created using sequence-disjoint segments rather than random frame sampling. This frame count was strategically chosen as manual 3D annotation of dense point clouds is exceptionally labor-intensive, yet the total count of over 1100 1100 well-distributed dynamic object instances across these frames provides a statistically robust and diverse evaluation set. At the selected location, the distribution of the road users is found to be in the range of 0 0 to 50 50 m from the sensor setup.
blocks.zh: 从lidar传感器中手动标注的3D边框作为本作中的地面真假(GT)数据. 不同的数据集专门用于培训和验证YawPrectiveNet模型. 同时,单列500帧独立编组,包含451 451人,360辆自行车,299 299辆汽车,专门用于验证拟议方法的最终3D OBB结果,在参数调试中省略. 为防止时间数据泄漏,数据集分裂是使用序列离散片段而不是随机帧采样生成的. 这一帧计数是战略选择的,因为人工3D对密集点云的注解是劳动密集型的,然而,在这些帧中分布良好的动态物体总计计数超过1100,100个,提供了统计学上稳健和多样的评价集。 在所选位置,发现道路使用者的分布距离传感器设置在0到50米之间.

blocks.en: Ablation experiments are conducted to determine optimal 3D bounding box dimensions (length, width, height) for pedestrians, bicycles, and cars. blocks.en: Table IV presents a comparative evaluation of the proposed methodology against two camera-only monocular homography baselines across target classes. Both baseline methods (B1 and B2) estimate the 3D centroid and height by projecting upper and lower 2D bounding box points onto the ground plane using state-of-the-art homography, relying on the 2D bounding box bottom-center instead of radar returns. For yaw angle estimation, B1 assumes axis-aligned bounding boxes (no yaw), whereas B2 assigns yaw angles based on road geography look-up tables.
blocks.zh: 表四对照两个各目标类别仅摄像头的单一图谱基线对拟议方法进行了比较评价。 两种基准方法(B1和B2)都通过利用最先进的测距法将上下2D的边框点投射到地面平面上,依靠2D边框底-中心点而不是雷达返回来估计3D的中间体和高度. 对于yaw角度估计,B1假设轴对齐的边框(没有yaw),而B2则根据道路地理查询表来分配yaw角度.

blocks.en: Across all object classes, the proposed approach significantly outperforms both baselines, particularly in centroid estimation ( x c , y c x_{c},y_{c} ) and yaw accuracy. For instance, in the car category, the longitudinal position error ( x c x_{c} ) is drastically reduced from ( 2.67 , 2.36 ) (2.67,2.36) m in B1/B2 to ( 0.38 , 0.29 ) (0.38,0.29) m, while the yaw error is reduced from ( 5.88 , 4.30 ) ∘ (5.88,4.30)^{\circ} (B2) down to ( 3.68 , 3.65 ) ∘ (3.68,3.65)^{\circ} . Similar substantial gains in positioning accuracy are achieved for pedestrians and bicycles. These improvements are directly attributed to the incorporation of sparse radar point clouds, which provide precise, physically grounded spatial cues that effectively eliminate the severe longitudinal depth ambiguity inherent to purely vision-based homography.

blocks.en: It is worth emphasizing that direct comparisons with end-to-end deep learning camera or fusion frameworks are intentionally omitted, as such models operate under entirely different computational paradigms. Heavy end-to-end architectures require extensive data, high-end hardware, and massive parameter budgets. In contrast, the proposed methodology offers a lightweight, highly efficient, and modular pipeline that executes seamlessly in real time at 25 FPS on an NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin edge platform, rendering it exceptionally suitable for practical edge deployments where computational resources are tightly constrained. Fig. 4 shows some visual examples for reference.
blocks.zh: 值得强调的是,有意省略了与端到端深度学习相机或聚变框架的直接比较,因为这些模型是在完全不同的计算范式下运行的. 沉重的端对端架构需要大量数据,高端硬件,以及大量的参数预算. 与此相反,拟议方法提供了一个轻量级、高效和模块化的管道,在NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin边缘平台上以25 FPS实时无缝执行,使其特别适合在计算资源受到严格制约的情况下进行实际边缘部署。 图4显示了一些可参考的例子。

blocks.en: VI Conclusion
blocks.zh: 六 结论

blocks.en: This paper presented a low-cost, resource-efficient two-stage framework for real-time 3D shape and orientation estimation of pedestrians, bicycles, and cars using roadside camera-radar setups. The methodology leverages associated sparse radar point clouds to establish precise 3D target positions, applies bounded dimension templates to stabilize object scale against point sparsity, and employs a lightweight neural network to regress site-specific yaw angles for bicycles and cars accurately. Comprehensive ablation studies established optimal dimension parameters, while comparative evaluations against camera-only homography baselines demonstrated significant performance gains. Operating at 25 25 FPS on an NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin, the proposed system provides a practical, edge-friendly solution for real-time roadside perception.
blocks.zh: 本文为行人,自行车,以及使用路边照相机-雷达设置的汽车的实时立体形状和定向估计提出了低成本,资源效率高的两阶段框架. 该方法利用相关稀疏的雷达点云来建立精确的3D目标位置,应用边框维度模板来稳定对象尺度与点溅射的对比,并使用轻量级神经网络为自行车和汽车准确反射特定地点的yaw角. 全面的消化研究确定了最佳维度参数,而对照只摄像头的测距基线进行比较评价则显示出显著的性能收益。 拟议的系统在NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin上的25 FPS上运行,为实时路边感知提供了一个实用的、方便边缘的解决方案。

blocks.en: Despite its efficiency, this work is limited to a single roadside setup, and fixed template bounds cannot capture fine-grained size variations across vehicle sub-classes. Future work will evaluate cross-site transferability across diverse sensor geometries and road geographies, implement dynamic templates, and expand support to heavy vehicles and motorbikes.
blocks.zh: 这项工作尽管效率高,但仅限于单一的路边设置,固定模板的界限无法捕捉车辆子类之间细纹大小的变化. 今后的工作将评价不同传感器地理图和道路地理图的跨地点可转让性,实施动态模板,并扩大对重型车辆和摩托车的支持。
